message: `Problem` — a slide id is lowercase, like the deck's ids (`title`, `market-opportunity`)
`outro` — one slide per marker; put the next on its own line
`page:` isn't a slide option — use `[slide ID]` or `[slide ID step:N]`
`lowerthird` isn't a speaker widget. Did you mean `lower-third`? — widgets: faces, lower-third, waveform, captions (`lower-third:always` to show it on every line), or `all` / `off`
`GEN` is generated (`prompt:`), but `[video …]` needs a video file: `GEN: { file: path/to/clip.mp4 }`
a video takes the screen, so it can't overlap anything — drop `at:`
